situations.headline: Novo Nordisk expands APAS installed base to three units, signals FY27 sales step-change

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Novo Nordisk expands APAS installed base to three units, signals FY27 sales step-change (interest 6, risk 6)

thesis.text: CCS is executing a 'Land and Expand' strategy with global pharma manufacturers, converting single-instrument evaluations into multi-unit orders as customers progress toward GMP-validated routine use; Novo Nordisk's move from one to three instruments plus a LIMS integration order is an early proof point supporting management's FY27 step-change sales guidance, though realized revenue remains dependent on each customer's independent validation timeline and conversion from the 8-strong global manufacturer cohort [asx:e74fe1b9db11519587eaf6cd75284a71 p.1].
